title: Fix-Decision Fix Contract
description: Envelope plus repair specialization. Must bind to its parent defect contract by exact path and digest, declare first-repair-authorizing status, and carry a parent_scope_trace (defect_key + in-scope disposition) for every authorized defect leg. Revisions within approved scope are first_repair_authorizing=false publications, not a third gate.
